exposure: presence or absence of spontaneous uterine contractions
cohort: 1,050 patients with diet-controlled gestational diabetes mellitus who delivered at 35-42 weeks' gestation
finding: The optimal delivery time for patients with diet-controlled gestational diabetes mellitus is recommended to be between 39 and 40 + 6 weeks' gestation.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery rates were increased significantly at 39-39 + 6 weeks due to iatrogenic intervention in patients without spontaneous uterine contractions and at 40-40 + 6 weeks in patients with spontaneous uterine contractions.
